about: <data root>/run/runtime.json, the record of what the task shims and server launchers run (src/relocate.mjs repairAfterMove, called by the panel at every start, ui.mjs serve, and by `spawnloft repair` with force). If format, exe or root differ from this process's, or there is no readable record, every shim and launcher is rewritten and the record is written again. test/contracts-files.test.mjs runs each case.

rules.signature: format is RUNTIME_FORMAT (2: 2.0 files run spawnloft-core); exe is SPAWNLOFT_ENTRY when it names an existing file (a 2.0 install), else the running executable; root is the Node code folder (paths.mjs ROOT, the folder holding src/ and mcctl.mjs: <resources>/core in a package), resolved, with no trailing separator.
rules.compare: only those three fields, with ===. Other fields are left for whoever wrote them.
rules.text: JSON.stringify({ ...recorded, ...signature }, null, 2) and \n: a recorded key keeps its place, so format, exe and root stay where an older record had them and are added at the end otherwise. A record that matches is not rewritten at all.
rules.rust: While both sides live, Rust writes root as the string Node computes (<resources>/core), or each would rewrite every shim after the other ran (PLAN-CORE-PORT.md 3.4). From C10 Rust ignores root when comparing.

cases.what: the same three fields: left alone, byte for byte
an older format, with a field of its own
a record with other keys first
an unreadable record counts as moved
